description: Embedded Capacity Register 1MW and Over is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Embedded Capacity Register (ECR) contains information on all generation, storage and flexible demand assets which are either already connected, or accepted to connect to the Northern Powergrid network. This information is updated by the 10th working day of each month and provides visibility to our stakeholders on distributed generation. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Connecting Generation. Its keywords are Generation, Connections, Storage, Methodology. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
